item.title: Jack Keane warns ceasefire with Iran would 'play right into their hands' as Trump signals deal progress
item.summary: Retired Gen. Jack Keane warns against an Iran ceasefire, saying it plays into Tehran's hands and that sustained military pressure is the path to a deal.

item.title: Trump says Iran gave 'significant' gift to prove country wants to 'make a deal' and more top headlines
item.summary: Get all the stories you need-to-know from the most powerful name in news delivered first thing every morning to your inbox.

item.title: Houston Rodeo ride malfunction leaves people dangling in air for several minutes
item.summary: A video captured people dangling in the air for several minutes during a recent amusement ride malfunction at the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo in Texas.

item.title: Doctor’s wife testifies he beat her with rock, tried to force her toward cliff edge during hike
item.summary: Arielle Konig testified her husband, a Hawaii anesthesiologist, beat her with a rock and tried to push her off a cliff during a birthday hike on Oahu.

item.title: NBA faces pressure to alter 65-game eligibility rule for players to be considered for awards
item.summary: The National Basketball Players Association called on the league to amend its 65-game eligibility rule for its stars to be considered for top awards.

item.title: Top Republican in North Carolina Senate concedes race decided by 23 votes
item.summary: North Carolina Republican Senate leader Phil Berger, endorsed by President Donald Trump, conceded the GOP primary race to Sheriff Sam Page after a second recount.

item.title: Air taxis in the US could launch this summer
item.summary: A new federal eVTOL program targets passenger, cargo, and medical flights across 26 states, with autonomous air taxi operations potentially on the horizon.

item.title: Beloved student Jimmy Gracey’s standing room only memorials span campus church service, fraternity vigil
item.summary: University of Alabama students packed a memorial mass for Jimmy Gracey as Barcelona police await autopsy results in his likely accidental death case.

item.title: SEE IT: Travelers sound off as ICE agents deployed to airports as shutdown drags past 40 days
item.summary: Travelers are divided over Trump's plan to deploy ICE agents to airports as the DHS shutdown leaves TSA workers unpaid and increasingly short-staffed.

item.title: Century-old US airport to shut down to make way for taxpayer-funded park as critics push for housing
item.summary: Santa Monica Airport, open for over 100 years, is set to close Dec. 31, 2028, after an FAA settlement that allows the city to end operations. It will be converted for public use.
